Based on my research, here's a comparison of six top-rated CRMs well-suited for small consulting firms, covering pricing, ratings, and features.

## Quick Comparison Table

| CRM | Starting Price | Ratings (G2 / Capterra) | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| **HubSpot CRM** | Free; paid tiers from ~$15–20/user/mo | 4.4/5 (G2, 13,000+ reviews) | Firms needing marketing + sales in one system |
| **Pipedrive** | $14/user/mo (Lite) | 4.2–4.3/5 (G2) · 4.5/5 (Capterra) | Sales-focused, transactional consulting work |
| **Zoho CRM** | Free tier; paid from ~$14–20/user/mo | 4.1/5 (G2, ~2,900 reviews) · 4.3/5 (Capterra, ~7,000 reviews) | Budget-conscious firms wanting deep customization |
| **Insightly** | $29/user/mo (Plus) | 4.2/5 (G2, 931 reviews) | Mid-sized firms merging CRM + project delivery |
| **Copper** | $9–12/user/mo (Starter, limited) | 4.5/5 (G2, ~1,150 reviews) | Google Workspace/Gmail-native teams |
| **monday CRM** | Free; $12/seat/mo (Basic) | 4.6/5 (G2, ~1,130 reviews) | Visual, flexible work-management + CRM combo |

## Detailed Breakdown

## Cost Context for Small Firms

When budgeting, note that

content.text: solo consultants should be in the $20-60/month range for pipeline tooling, while small consulting firms (2-5 people) typically land at $150-400/month across CRM, proposals, projects, invoicing, and portal — either bundled into an all-in-one or split across 5-7 tools.

## Recommendation Summary
- **Best all-around value**: Zoho CRM (affordable, feature-rich, free tier available)
- **Best for relationship-driven consulting**: HubSpot or Copper (Gmail-native)
- **Best for pure pipeline/sales tracking**: Pipedrive
- **Best for CRM + delivery/project management**: Insightly
- **Best highest-rated, flexible option**: monday CRM
- **Best if you're already in Google Workspace**: Copper
